# Joey Interrante (Joseph Interrante)

> Joey Interrante, also known as Joseph Interrante, is a professional drummer based in Tampa Bay, Florida, available for live shows, private events, corporate events, weddings, and session recording.

Joey performs regularly across the Tampa Bay area with multiple acts. He is the drummer for Kid Royal Band featuring guitarist Josh Nelms, known for their Wednesday Blues residency at Bayboro Brewing Co. He also performs as part of Dog and Pony Trio at Middle Grounds Grill, and as a duo with Gale Trippsmith under the names Gale and Joey and Joey and Gale at venues including Bamboo Beach Bar, Woody's River Roo, Proper Pint, and O'Maddy's Bar and Grille. He has performed at notable Tampa Bay venues including Mahaffey Theater, Saltwater Hippie, and Bayboro Brewing Co.

- Bamboo Beach Bar — Tampa Bay area. Gale and Joey duo, weekly performances
- Middle Grounds Grill — Tampa Bay area. Dog and Pony Trio
- Woody's River Roo — Bradenton, FL. Gale and Joey Duo
- O'Maddy's Bar and Grille — Seminole, FL. Joey and Gale
- Proper Pint — Tampa Bay area. Gale and Joey Duo
- Mahaffey Theater — St. Petersburg, FL. Special events

## Acts
- Kid Royal Band featuring Josh Nelms — blues and roots rock
- Dog and Pony Trio — live music trio
- Gale and Joey — acoustic duo with Gale Trippsmith
- Gale Trippsmith — singer-songwriter performances

## Genres
Joey performs across multiple genres including Florida blues, Americana, rock, alternative, country, acoustic rock, and alt-rock.
